models_loaded.CLIP-ViT-L-14: not attempted (download time and memory budget)
models_loaded.LLaVA-1.5-7B: not loaded (no GPU + no large local weights). Approximated by CLIP-based VQA.

named_method_fidelity.exact_LLaVA_or_InstructBLIP_VQA: approximated by CLIP image-text similarity over multiple-choice options because of CPU/RAM constraints

limitations: Full LLaVA / InstructBLIP inference is replaced by CLIP zero-shot scoring of MC options. The cropping mechanism itself (relevancy map -> bbox -> zoom-in -> ensemble) is implemented faithfully and applied to the same CLIP visual encoder family used inside LLaVA-1.5.
All compute is CPU; we use ViT-B/16 (instead of ViT-L/14) for tractable runtime.
